description:
Migrate the parallel permanent's Gray-walk chunk length in gf2-algebra to a runtime resolved read of gf2-core's profile.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3.12, D4, and the permanent row of §4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gray_chunk_subsets is a runtime resolved read at permanent_bipedal3_parallel reaching the existing _with_chunk parameter, satisfying design §2.3, with no new dependency edge in either direction.
- [hard] REQ-02: The permanent_chunk_len accessor is exercised by an installed-profile witness that the chunk reaches the callee, and a determinism witness across chunk lengths passes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc names the profile field; existing tests pass unchanged.
title: Cut the parallel-permanent chunk length over to the tuning profile
